import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
public class A {
    private static List<Long> powers;
    private static List<Long> subsetSums;

    private static void generateSubsets(int index, long currentSum) {
        if (index == powers.size()) {
            subsetSums.add(currentSum);
            return;
        }
        generateSubsets(index + 1, currentSum + powers.get(index));
        generateSubsets(index + 1, currentSum);
    }

    private static boolean isValid(long M, long W, long candidate) {
        if (candidate == M) return true;
        long value = candidate + M;
        while (value > 0) {
            if (value % W > 1) return false;
            value /= W;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] input = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        long W = Long.parseLong(input[0]);
        long M = Long.parseLong(input[1]);

        if (W == 2) {
            System.out.println("YES");
            return;
        }

        powers = new ArrayList<>();
        powers.add(1L);
        powers.add(W);
        long current = W;
        final long LIMIT = (long)1e10;

        while (true) {
            current *= W;
            if (current <= 0 || current > LIMIT) break;
            powers.add(current);
        }

        subsetSums = new ArrayList<>();
        generateSubsets(0, 0L);

        boolean found = false;
        for (long s : subsetSums) {
            if (isValid(M, W, s)) {
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(found ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}
